Please compile a list of desktop graphics cards released by this company from 1990 to 2024 (inclusive). This semiconductor company was founded in the early 1990s. Its parallel computing platform, launched in the late 2000s, enabled researchers to run C-like programs on graphics chips to accelerate large-scale simulations. By the mid-2010s, it was being used by over 40,000 institutions worldwide for AI research. Its hardware platform also powers a real-time collaborative simulation system released in 2022 for building industrial-grade metaverse applications. The list should include specific product series, product name, chip name, release date, bus interface, memory capacity, memory type, memory bus width, core frequency (base frequency), and memory frequency.

Please output the compiled data in a Markdown table. The column names in the table are: Product Series, Product Name, Chip Name, Release Date, Bus Interface, Memory Capacity, Memory Type, Memory Bus Width, Core Frequency, and Memory Frequency. The release date should be formatted as "September 12, 2012." If the same graphics card product is based on multiple chips (GPUs), please list each chip on its own row.

Don't ask me any questions; simply output the results in columns, and don't omit cells. The output format should be ```markdown
{data_content}
```.
